name: Nerf Mobs
description: HP x0.5 / DMG x0.75 / ARM x0.75, slower attacks.

sql.statement: UPDATE creature_template SET HealthModifier=HealthModifier*{hp}, DamageModifier=DamageModifier*{dmg}, ArmorModifier=ArmorModifier*{arm}, BaseAttackTime=BaseAttackTime*{spd}, RangeAttackTime=RangeAttackTime*{spd};

UPDATE creature_template SET HealthModifier=HealthModifier/{hp}, DamageModifier=DamageModifier/{dmg}, ArmorModifier=ArmorModifier/{arm}, BaseAttackTime=BaseAttackTime/{spd}, RangeAttackTime=RangeAttackTime/{spd};
sql.note: inverse of the APPLIED values (wow-manage.sh stores them in the marker file); applying twice stacks multipliers

notes: Mob tweaks are mutually exclusive: installing one removes any sibling first (wow-manage.sh 4601-4611). Back up acore_world before applying.
